notes: Native sizes include at most31 bytes of alignment padding. Counts are static, not dynamic cost.
Native hot PCs use actual frozen runtime image function offsets, not standalone-map addresses.
C is the equivalent generated C compiled with cc -O2. GCC may inline helpers; absent symbols are not invented.
Before profiles are single31-batch processes; cfg profiles pool4; compare shares with that sampling limitation.
Source/IR instruction mapping requires verified instruction-byte correspondence; no unsupported exact PC-to-IR claim.

Native function/source definitions are matched through the actual RX function offset table and source declaration names. They do not claim a precise hot PC to source line mapping: the standalone map has different lowering options and no source origins for these frozen bundles.
